title: Which type of load balancer?
claim: The kind of traffic decides which type of load balancer fits.
alt: A decision ladder with three questions. If traffic passes through firewalls or other virtual appliances, choose a Gateway Load Balancer. If not, and the traffic is HTTP or HTTPS, choose an Application Load Balancer. If not, and the traffic is TCP, UDP or TLS, choose a Network Load Balancer. If every answer is no, read the requirement again.
notes: Pilot for the diagram gate. QA on 2026-10-04: 2 rounds, lint clean. Not checked against the fact canon: ground the three traffic rules before chapter 14 uses it. There is no rung for a static IP address on purpose: that rule is a hard fact with exceptions. Known limits: the bottom outcome is a fallback and not a load balancer, because two rungs cannot share one outcome; the line breaks in the questions are forced.
